Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

WildChat: 1M ChatGPT Interaction Logs in the Wild (2405.01470v1) · paper method: The source reports Presidio, spaCy named-entity recognition and custom rules for multilingual PII removal, followed by GeoLite2 country/state mapping and hashed IP release; it explicitly notes that hashed IPs and request headers could still enable linking conversations from the same user.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

WildChat: 1M ChatGPT Interaction Logs in the Wild (2405.01470v1) · paper method: For the paper’s publicly accessible GPT-3.5-Turbo and GPT-4 chatbot services, users could access the chat interface only after accepting a data collection/use/sharing agreement and acknowledging a secondary confirmation; the source describes collection from April 9, 2023 to May 1, 2024.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

WildChat: 1M ChatGPT Interaction Logs in the Wild (2405.01470v1) · paper method: The exact v1 PDF states a public release of 1,039,785 conversations after reserving 14,743 for WildBench, but the following Basic Statistics paragraph states 1,009,245 conversations; the two figures are inconsistent and this packet does not reconcile them into one canonical artifact count.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

WildChat: 1M ChatGPT Interaction Logs in the Wild (2405.01470v1) · paper method: The limitations caution that Hugging Face hosting and subreddit dissemination can skew users toward IT-related communities, and account-free anonymous access may select more toxic discourse; the dataset is not established as representative of all chatbot users.
